name: Snapjaws, Mon!
label: Quest
description: In the Hinterlands, Katoom the Angler of Revantusk Village can barely keep a line in the water because saltwater snapjaws keep wrecking it and stealing…
intro: In the Hinterlands, Katoom the Angler of Revantusk Village can barely keep a line in the water because saltwater snapjaws keep wrecking it and stealing his bait. He wants fifteen of the turtles dead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.
Do me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.
Kill the whole lot of em!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, mon! I can't thank you enough! Hopefully this here fishing pole will be reward enough for the job.
